mcqs.question: Big Data refers to data sets that are:
options: Small and easy to manage in a spreadsheet
So large and complex that traditional data processing tools cannot capture, store and process them efficiently
Always stored on a single computer

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the main characteristics (Vs) of Big Data?
In Big Data, "Volume" refers to:
options: The speed at which data is generated
The huge amount of data generated and stored

mcqs.question: In Big Data, "Velocity" refers to:
options: The total size of the data
The speed at which data is generated and must be processed
The business value of the data

mcqs.question: In Big Data, "Variety" refers to:
options: The different types and formats of data

mcqs.question: In Big Data, "Veracity" refers to:
options: The trustworthiness and quality of data

mcqs.question: In Big Data, "Value" refers to:
options: The price of the storage devices
Extracting useful insights and benefits from the data
The number of files in a system

Scalability in a Big Data system means:
options: The system slows down as data grows
The ability of the system to handle growing amounts of data by adding resources

mcqs.question: Horizontal scaling means:
options: Adding more machines or nodes to a system
Adding more RAM to a single machine

mcqs.question: Vertical scaling means:
options: Adding more machines to a system
Increasing the resources (CPU, RAM) of a single machine
Adding more users to a system

mcqs.question: Traditional database systems struggle with Big Data mainly because they:
options: Are too fast for small data
Are not designed to store and process massive, fast-growing and varied data

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an application of Big Data in healthcare?
options: Disease prediction and better patient care through data analysis

mcqs.question: The main benefit of Big Data for a business is:
options: Better and faster decision making based on data analysis

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a major challenge of Big Data?
options: Too little data is produced in the world

mcqs.question: Which technology is widely used for distributed storage and processing of Big Data?
HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File System) is used to:
options: Store large files distributed across many machines

mcqs.question: MapReduce is:
options: A programming model used to process large data sets in parallel across a cluster

mcqs.question: NoSQL databases are preferred for Big Data because they:
options: Provide a flexible schema and can scale across many servers
